instruction.text: Now, match the verb tenses to the descriptions on how the different tenses are formed.
instruction.sound: Now, match the verbtenses to the descriptions on how the different tenses are formed.

atoms.a: This verb tense is formed with the helping verb had + the past participle form of a verb.
atoms.sound: ssml: This verb tense is formed with the helping verb. had. plus, the past participle form of a verb.

atoms.a: This verb tense is formed with the helping verbs have/has + the past participle form of a verb.
atoms.sound: ssml: This verb tense is formed with the helping verbs have or has. plus the past participle form of a verb.

atoms.a: This verb tense is formed with the helping words will + have + the past participle form of a verb.
atoms.sound: ssml: This verb tense is formed with the helping words. will. plus have. plus the past participle form of a verb.

instruction.text: Look at the underlined verbs in the sentence. Which tense is it?

atoms.a: Julia <u>had not recalled</u> being told to wash her clothes.
He <u>has prepared</u> for tomorrow’s interview thoroughly.
Your aunt <u>will have picked</u> you up from your friend’s house by 9pm, so you can go to bed on time.
Next summer, we <u>will have completed</u> the renovations on our house.
